categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in green new-type building materials and related sectors. Primary business segments include: (1) Building modular systems (aluminum formwork, steel formwork, steel-frame wood formwork, basement templates, industrial early-removal systems, platform templates, clear-water concrete formwork, and public infrastructure formwork); (2) Prefabricated building components (PC and steel structure); (3) Modular housing (PC and steel structure); and (4) New energy business related to green buildings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including: (1) Intelligent design systems with self-developed aluminum formwork configuration software, GETO background beam automation system, and 3D modeling software; (2) Smart manufacturing systems featuring fully automated production lines with automatic punching, intelligent welding robots, and unmanned operations across all processes; (3) Digital transformation achieving L8 certification level; (4) BIM intelligent technology for building information modeling; (5) Standardized and precision manufacturing processes for aluminum formwork systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include large domestic construction enterprises and international construction companies. Key end markets served are: (1) Residential building construction (standard and non-standard floors); (2) Underground structures and basement construction; (3) Industrial buildings and cold-chain logistics facilities; (4) Public infrastructure projects (bridges, tunnels, pipe galleries, dams); (5) Public buildings and non-residential projects; (6) International markets across 60+ countries and regions including Southeast Asia, Middle East, Central Asia, Australia, Africa, and South America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in: (1) Domestic regions: Guangdong, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Shandong, Gansu, Sichuan, Chongqing, Liaoning, and Hainan; (2) International markets: Singapore, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, Kazakhstan, Hong Kong, Macau, and operations across 60+ countries. The company has established 12 major production bases globally and registered GETO® trademarks in 32 countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: (1) Upstream: Raw material sourcing (aluminum profiles, steel materials) from major domestic suppliers; (2) Midstream: Manufacturing and production of formwork systems and prefabricated components; (3) Downstream: Direct sales and rental services to construction contractors and project developers; (4) Service provision: Technical support, installation guidance, and project management services throughout the construction lifecycle.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing intelligent design and automated manufacturing capabilities; (2) Expanding product portfolio through modular housing and prefabricated building systems; (3) Developing new energy solutions including distributed photovoltaic and energy storage systems; (4) Pursuing international market expansion along Belt and Road Initiative countries; (5) Enhancing digital transformation with focus on design systems, factory management platforms, and supply chain digitalization; (6) Developing specialized products for public infrastructure projects (bridges, tunnels, pipe galleries); (7) Improving product standardization and recyclability.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) Rental model: Leasing aluminum formwork and safety protection platforms to construction projects, with revenue recognized based on actual usage area and contract unit price; (2) Sales model: Direct product sales of formwork systems, prefabricated components, and modular housing with revenue recognized upon control transfer; (3) Service model: Technical consulting, installation guidance, and project management services; (4) New energy model: Distributed photovoltaic and energy storage system sales and consulting services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the aluminum formwork and green building materials industry. It holds the position of: (1) Vice Chairman of China Formwork and Scaffolding Association; (2) Chairman of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area Aluminum Formwork and Climbing Frame Branch; (3) Recipient of industry honors including 'Famous Enterprise in Formwork and Scaffolding Industry' and 'Leading Enterprise in Modular Architecture Industry'; (4) Holder of special-grade qualifications from industry associations. The industry is characterized by fragmented competition with approximately 200 major enterprises, and the company competes through superior product quality, comprehensive services, and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company demonstrates solid financial scale and growth: (1) 2024 revenue: 2,526.39 million yuan, up 12.88% year-over-year; (2) 2024 net profit attributable to parent company: 73.70 million yuan, up 262.69% from 2023; (3) Total assets: 5,455.82 million yuan as of end-2024; (4) Shareholders' equity: 1,522.91 million yuan; (5) Operating cash flow: 30.61 million yuan in 2024 (improved from negative 475.50 million yuan in 2023); (6) Overseas revenue: 519.92 million yuan, up 41.85% year-over-year, representing 20.58% of total revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation is built on: (1) Superior product quality and precision manufacturing with high standardization rates; (2) Comprehensive one-stop service model covering design, production, rental, and technical support across project lifecycle; (3) Advanced intelligent design and automated manufacturing capabilities reducing errors and improving efficiency; (4) Strong brand recognition with international certifications (Singapore BCA BAND2, Malaysia CIDB G7); (5) Extensive service network with 12 global production bases and presence in 60+ countries; (6) Innovation in product applications extending from standard residential to infrastructure and public buildings; (7) Integration of green building materials with new energy solutions providing comprehensive sustainability solutions.
